tonight.headline: 14.9 to 3.4 — but Golden caught one ball
body: Bad news first. Golden caught 1 of 5 targets for 4.9 points against a 16.7 projection; no injury was reported, and Watson's halftime concussion took Green Bay's other starting receiver off the field (PFF). Jacobs was inactive again with the finger. Tuten has not practised since Wednesday's DNP and Likely was limited Wednesday — Thursday's reports come this afternoon. You are 3-8.

The Rams D/ST scored 10, so you lead 14.9 to 3.4. Today: JuiceJam's Gibbs and Jameson Williams at Detroit at noon, Pickens for you against Philadelphia at 15:30. ESPN has it 120.4 to 119.8, 50%. Nothing to move today; the Sunday fallbacks stand.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Gibbs (25.7 projected) runs wild on Thanksgiving, then Tuten and Likely sit on Sunday without the fallbacks made — 31 projected points become Taylor's 14.0 and a zero.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuten practising Thursday or Friday, or Likely upgraded to full. A big Pickens afternoon against Philadelphia's secondary banks the lead.
